field_principles.canonical_live_agent_entrypoint_receipts: fresh rows must come through make_carnot_agent/E3AgentPolicy, not a shadow-only collector.
field_principles.duplicate_solve_target_count: bare zero because cleared public games are evaluation fixtures, not solve targets.
field_principles.duration_s: wall-clock duration covers registry precheck, acquisition, sealing, shadow scoring, controls, and validation.

field_principles.field_provenance: every required field traces to spec, registry receipts, live rows, frozen policies, controls, or command receipts.
field_principles.fresh_transition_paths_hashes_and_counts: the fresh transition corpus path, hash, row counts, and per-game counts are sealed before policy scoring.
field_principles.frozen_policy_paths_and_hashes: Exp6195/Exp6167 frozen task-aware and global policy code, config, result, and manifests are content-addressed before shadow scoring.
field_principles.honest_verdict: complete_positive:, complete_null:, or blocked: states LOO game count, fresh transition count, shadow delta, losing-game count, and no-solve status.
field_principles.level_credit_delta: bare zero because no public-game level credit is requested.
field_principles.live_action_influence_count: bare zero because shadow policies run only after live actions are already collected.
field_principles.loo_accuracy_quality_and_safety_by_game: per-game accuracy, quality, safety, and losing/tied/winning status are reported so aggregate lift cannot hide a losing game.
field_principles.paired_clustered_intervals: task-aware minus global intervals are paired on identical transitions and clustered by game and seed.
field_principles.preregistered_loo_game_seed_matrix: held-out games, seeds, action budget, and minimum fresh-transition count are frozen before acquisition.
field_principles.registry_precheck_and_hash_before_after: registry is parsed and hashed before acquisition and after artifact assembly; all chosen games are already-cleared fixtures and the hash must remain unchanged.
field_principles.registry_update_count: bare zero because ops/arc_solve_registry.yaml is not updated.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: content-addressed checksum detects later artifact drift.
field_principles.solve_claimed: bare false because this task claims no level solve.
field_principles.source_bfs_adapter_prior_game_hidden_sta: every forbidden source, BFS, adapter, prior-game, hidden-state, LLM, and reproduce access count must be bare zero.
field_principles.status: terminal state is complete_positive, complete_null, or blocked for the shadow leave-one-game-out measurement.
field_principles.task_aware_and_global_shadow_decisions: both frozen policies score identical sealed rows in shadow and cannot request observations or choose live actions.
field_principles.test_commands: records focused unit/spec coverage, coverage for new code, validation, adversarial, live-path lint, root-clutter, E2E-applicable, and full pytest checks.
field_principles.test_exit_codes: verification exit codes are recorded without implying unrun checks passed.
field_principles.train_eval_overlap_counts: each held-out fold reports zero training/evaluation game overlap and zero held rows used for fit.
field_principles.treatment_activation_and_aa_controls: treatment activation, A/A replay invariance, row-order, label-alias, and no-influence controls must pass before a positive verdict.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: false; observed transitions evaluate shadow decisions but do not become a live action oracle.
